descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-24 ER 4; TFA-94514 req 2 · “Completing a task and deleting a task are separate actions, and each is logged separately for analytics (OAT-06).”.

Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S09 Complete and Delete are separate taps and separate events on every task surface, including the Tasks overlay, in both modes

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Completing a task and deleting a task are separate actions, and each is logged as its own analytics event (task completed / task deleted), one per tap, against the chart. (UAT TC-24; UAT OAT-06 item 7; TFA-94514 AC 2)
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Hospital patient with five open tasks; Nursing Home resident with two open tasks

When Hospital Encounter tab: Complete 'Recheck BMP in AM', Delete 'PT eval before discharge'. Hospital Post-Round: Complete 'Order echo', Delete 'Call case management'. Account-wide Tasks overlay from the Hospital list: Complete 'Check telemetry'. …

Then Completed tasks show as done (not deleted); deleted tasks are gone. Exactly three task-completed events (one from the overlay) and two task-deleted events against the Hospital chart, and one of each against the resident, none carrying task text; the day rollup's tasksCompleted / tasksDeleted match.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-24 bullet 4 + OAT-06 item 7 + TFA-94514 AC 2. UI checkpoints via oracle.mjs; event counts by a post-run backend read of pilotUsageEvents (event, patientId, careSetting) and pilotDailyRounding for the run account, exact counts per chart and event. The overlay Complete must add exactly one task_completed for that chart. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S09

Local QA stack only (main e02167f), a brand-new @roundai.test physician per test, synthetic charts deleted after the reads. No model: every ai/* action is refused at the Convex socket and none was sent; tripwire clean for the final run (16:43:28Z mark, 'no model call'). Rows are read with the local admin key (patientActivity / usage / surveys _recentForActor, usage:_dailyForActor) before and after the steps; reading them through Vikram's dashboard on the UAT deployment is S23 / Q12. Seeded a Hospital chart with the five testData tasks and a resident with 'Weekly weight Monday' and 'Podiatry referral'. Encounter tab: Complete 'Recheck BMP in AM', Delete 'PT eval before discharge'; Post-Round: Complete 'Order echo', Delete 'Call case management'; Task Export overlay from the Hospital list: Complete 'Check telemetry'; Nursing Home Post-Round: Complete 'Weekly weight Monday', Delete 'Podiatry referral'. Judged 17/17: both checkpoints (Hospital Post-Round lists the three completed tasks as done, each with a Reopen button, and not the two deleted ones; Nursing Home Post-Round shows 'Weekly weight Monday', not 'Podiatry referral'); stored chart: completed tasks done, deleted ones gone; each of the 7 taps wrote exactly one row of its kind; exactly 3 task_completed (one from the overlay) and 2 task_deleted against the Hospital chart (hospital), 1 + 1 against the resident (nursing_home); the overlay Complete added exactly one task_completed for the Hospital chart; rollup hospital +3 / +2, nursing_home +1 / +1; no task text or name in any row.
